title: 第13章 脾气不好小师妹
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“三师兄既然都说了我是天底下脾气最好最善良的小师妹，那我肯定不会生气的。不过师兄，以后外面这些话，记得少信。”

    微生璃月本来也就是想吓一吓他，装过之后便准备来到谢长泽这边，先认识认识这位炮灰大师兄。

    谁承想经过林不语身边时，“扑通”一声，林不语正好面朝着她，双膝重重地亲吻地面。

    微生璃月：这是怎么回事，这人陷害她？

    谢长泽：小师妹这……看来三师弟所说传闻不假，小师妹脾气确实不好。

    陆明薇：幸好她刚刚没有参与讨论。

    林不语：幸好只是跪一下，没像那叶不凡一样被生生捏碎右臂，小师妹对他还是仁慈了。

    至于做了这一切的微生天一：哼，敢说她家小姐脾气不好，该罚。

    微生璃月表面强装淡定，实则心里已经在疯狂尖叫，林不语陷害她，自己明明什么都没做，他怎么就突然朝着自己跪下来了？

    然而下一刻，装逼值到账的提示音响起：

    “检测到谢长泽对宿主情绪起伏过大，装逼值+600。”

    “检测到陆明薇对宿主情绪波动较大，装逼值+400。”

    “检测到濮阳明珠对宿主敬畏加深，装逼值+300。”

    “检测到林不语对宿主产生畏惧，装逼值+200。”

    “恭喜宿主装逼值累积已达10000点，奖励装逼成长礼包一份。”

    1500点装逼值入账，微生璃月哪里还会在乎林不语这点陷害，左右她又不掉块肉。

    至于脾气不好？她的人设本来就不是什么脾气好的人，名声坏点就坏点吧！

    “听说大师兄找我，是有什么事情吗？”微生璃月装得一片淡定，仿佛什么事情都没发生一样。

    其余人见状，更确定了林不语这一跪，是小师妹下的手。

    再联系起林不语说的那些传闻，谢长泽心里也泛起嘀咕，自己这个小师妹，还是不惹为好：“其实也没什么大事，这不是师父不在，我作为剑峰大师兄，应当带两位师妹了解一下太虚宗，适应这里的生活。”

    “听说两位师妹家中都有修行前辈，那些基础的入门修炼手册师兄就不送给你们了。这是师兄准备的两柄灵剑，送给两位师妹，在进入剑冢领取本命灵剑之前，可以拿来练手。”
content_en:
"Since Third Senior Brother has said that I am the best-tempered and kind-hearted little Junior Sister in the world, then I will definitely not be angry. But Senior Brother, please remember not to believe these words from the outside in the future."

Weisheng Liyue originally wanted to scare him. After pretending, she was ready to come to Xie Changze to get to know the cannon fodder senior brother first.

Unexpectedly, when she passed by Lin Buyu, there was a "plop" and Lin Buyu was facing her, kissing the ground heavily with her knees.

Weisheng Liyue: What's going on? This person framed her?

Xie Changze: Junior sister... It seems that the rumors mentioned by the third junior brother are true. Junior sister does have a bad temper.

Lu Mingwei: Fortunately, she didn’t participate in the discussion just now.

Lin Buyu: Fortunately, he only knelt down and his right arm was not crushed like that of Ye Bufan. The junior sister was still kind to him.

As for Wei Sheng Tianyi who did all this: Humph, I dare to say that her young lady has a bad temper and deserves punishment.

Weisheng Liyue pretended to be calm on the surface, but in fact she was screaming madly in her heart. Lin Buyu framed her. She clearly did nothing, so why did he suddenly kneel down towards her?

However, the next moment, the prompt sounded that the pretentious value had been paid:

"It is detected that Xie Changze's emotions towards the host are too high. The pretentiousness value is +600."

"It has been detected that Lu Mingwei's mood fluctuates greatly towards the host, and the pretentiousness value is +400."

"It is detected that Puyang Pearl has deepened its awe of the host, and the pretentiousness value is +300."

"It is detected that Lin Buyu is afraid of the host, the pretentiousness value is +200."

"Congratulations to the host for reaching 10,000 pretentious points. You will be rewarded with a pretentious growth gift pack."

With 1,500 points of pretentiousness in her account, how could Weisheng Liyue care about Lin Buyu's frame-up? She wouldn't lose a piece of meat.

As for having a bad temper?Her character is not that of a good-tempered person, so if her reputation is bad, then she will be bad!

"I heard that Senior Brother is looking for me. Is there something wrong?" Weisheng Liyue pretended to be calm, as if nothing happened.

Seeing this, the others were even more certain that Lin Buyu's kneeling was caused by the younger junior sister.

Reconnecting with the rumors that Lin Buyu mentioned, Xie Changze also murmured in his heart that it would be better not to mess with his junior sister: "Actually, it's not a big deal. It's not that the master is absent. As the senior brother of Jianfeng, I should help the two junior sisters to understand Taixu Sect and adapt to the life here."

"I heard that the two junior sisters have senior practitioners in their families. Senior brother will not give those basic introductory training manuals to you. These are two spiritual swords prepared by senior brother and given to the two junior sisters. They can be used to practice before entering the sword tomb to receive the natal spiritual swords."
title_en: Chapter 13 The little junior sister with a bad temper
